statement: The pinned xpadneo defaults to enabling a connection-notification rumble sequence that separately addresses the main motors and, if permitted, both trigger motors before normal FF streaming is marked ready. The driver exposes EV_FF FF_RUMBLE with effect upload, erase and playback callbacks, rejects unsupported effect uploads, and turns streaming off while draining workers on removal. This is driver-generated initialization traffic and must not be misclassified as an application's independently commanded impulse rumble.

applicability.revision: standard Series model 1914, comparisons explicitly scoped to other models
applicability.firmware: not physically measured; source version is pinned
applicability.scope: rumble.c:31-36, 229-353, 357-482; xpadneo.h:55-105. Behavior depends on ff_connect_notify and quirk flags.
